effects.effect: Your jump [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) and height double (see Movement Types in Chapter 10: [Combat](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/chapter/combat)). Additionally, when you fall, you reduce the effective height of your fall by a number of squares equal to your jump [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) for the purpose of determining damage and whether you [land prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) (see Falling in Chapter 10). You [are not prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) after falling and landing on another creature.
